Kiwa Seisakujo (貴和製作所) bead-and-parts store: product categories run by material and maker origin (Kiwa Crystals, Czech glass, freshwater pearl, natural stone, seed beads, metal parts, Spanish/Greek/Italian/German parts, gold-filled, silver 925, charms)

Potclays: clay by colour and body (white stoneware and porcelain, buff, red, crank and raku, paper clay), powdered glazes and frits, pottery tools, kilns split by type (electric, top-loading, front-loading, industrial, gas, plug-and-go) with maker ranges (Rohde, Kilncare Ikon, L&L, Nabertherm)

Tamiya plastic-modeling basic guide: workflow-ordered tool kinds (cutting mat, side cutters, putty, masking, paints, brushes, airbrush, weathering, decals); paints split by chemistry (lacquer LP, acrylic X/XF, enamel, spray TS/AS)
Humbrol: model paint range splits by chemistry (water-based acrylic vs solvent-based enamel) with aerosol spray separate; finishes Matt/Satin/Gloss/Metallic

UNSPSC family 60120000 Arts and crafts equipment, accessories and supplies: ~35 classes by craft/technique (art; canvases/boards/papers; paint and mediums; drawing; printmaking; inks; art fabric; sewing/stitchery/weaving; candlemaking; wood crafts; basketry; stained glass; paper crafts; mosaics; enamelling; beads; foam; ribbon; leather craft; macrame; marbling; clay and ceramics; art metals; sculpture)

HS 2022 heading 3213 'artists', students' or signboard painters' colours' in tablets/tubes/jars: only split is 'in sets' (321310) vs other (321390); customs names students and artists together, no grade split
Eckersley's: Winsor & Newton ranges Cotman (student) vs Professional (artist): pigment load, single-pigment colours, lightfastness; grade is a range of the same paint kind

Sennelier: 'extra fine/artist quality' vs 'fine/student grade' (pigment concentration about twice as high), price series 1-6 by pigment cost (extra-fine only), ASTM lightfastness I-V, opacity O/T codes

ASTM D4236 art-materials chronic-hazard labelling standard catalogue entry (ICS 97.195; fetch returned catalogue text only, scope read in search excerpt of same page): applies to art materials packaged for individual users

Singer/Husqvarna Viking machine filters: Category (Sewing Machine, Sewing & Embroidery, Overlock/Serger), Machine Type (Computerized, Heavy Duty, Mechanical), brand, feature facets, price bands; 'how to choose' groups by use (mending, everyday/heavy duty, feature-rich, embroidery)
Bernina: machine families Sewing, Quilting, Embroidery, Overlocker, Longarm Quilting; mechanical vs computerized; explains an overlock is a different machine (looper system), not a stitch setting
Brother AU: function filter Sewing / Quilting / Embroidery / Sewing-Quilting-Embroidery / Overlocker; mechanical vs computerised; 'what are you making' use filter
ISMACS vintage sewing machine collectors: organised by Manufacturers (name on the machine), serial-number databases and slide charts (Singer, Pfaff, Wanzer), models by maker and era

Tandy Leather categories: leather itself split by tannage/type (Veg-Tan, Chrome Tan, Designer, Utility, Printed and Embossed, Suede, Hair-On), then Hand Tools, Machines, Stamps, Hardware, Kits, Templates, Thread and Lace, Adhesives, Care and Finishes, Paint and Dye, Belt Strips, Craft Cuts, Leather Shapes; spec fields weight/thickness, tannage, size

Leather described on three independent axes: tannage (vegetable, chrome, brain, combination), grade (full grain, top grain, corrected, genuine, bonded) and weight (1-10 oz), plus animal source; named tanneries (Hermann Oak, Wickett and Craig) as quality marks

Fire Mountain Gems beads: category facets Beads (31,546), Seed Beads, Rhinestones, Pendants/Drops/Focals, Findings, Clasps, Bails, Crimp Beads, Chain; sub-category by form (Czech fire-polished, Rivoli, flat back, drops), brand (Miyuki, Matsuno), brand shape numbers, embellishment (faceted, carved), material in product titles
Scrapbook.com store: scrapbooking and cardmaking supplies by product kind (dies, stamps, inks, adhesives, paper pads, stencils, tools, storage), collection/brand bundles; theme scrapbooking

Google Product Taxonomy (2021-09-21): Arts and Crafts split into Kits, Art and Crafting Materials (paper, fasteners, paint-ink-glaze, shapes, adhesives, crafting fibers [yarn, thread, unspun fibre, cord], wire, embellishments and trims [beads, feathers, findings, ribbons], filling, leather and vinyl, pottery and sculpting [clay, slips], textiles [fabric, canvas]), Tool Accessories, Tools (needles and hooks, textile craft machines [sewing machine, loom, spinning wheel], thread and yarn tools, cutting), Craft Organization, Patterns and Molds; sibling Model Making (kits, trains, rocketry)

WISEPIM rendering of Google category 5710 Hobbies and Creative Arts with IDs and child counts: Arts and Crafts has 170 descendants (Materials 82, Tools 58); shows Sewing Machines (615) as a leaf under Textile Craft Machines, Knitting Needles and Crochet Hooks under Needles and Hooks; Collectibles and Model Making are siblings
Getty AAT hierarchy page places 'Tools and Equipment' under Furnishings and Equipment, with sub-groupings by general type and by mode of operation; no grouping by hobby appears

Etsy Craft Supplies and Tools top-level department with sub-departments such as Sewing and Fiber and Jewelry and Beauty supplies (marketplace splits supplies by craft family, separate from finished goods)

Wikipedia Sewing machine: stitches in four families (chainstitch, lockstitch, overlock, coverstitch), feed mechanisms (drop, needle, walking foot, puller, manual), and industrial vs domestic as the main type split

Yarn weight chart mapping CYC categories 0-7 to UK names (DK, Aran, Chunky) and AU ply (8 ply = DK), gauge, needle and hook sizes, wraps per inch and metres per 50 g; shows weight is a measurable spec with regional names

KnitPicks needles and hooks: Type facets (straight, fixed circular, interchangeable, double pointed, crochet hooks) separate from Material and Shape facets (wood, stainless steel, aluminium, bamboo, Foursquare); series are named lines (Radiant, Caspian, Sunstruck, Options)

Pottery clay in three body classes (earthenware low fire, stoneware mid/high, porcelain high) ranked by pyrometric cone/temperature (cone 022-14); cone rating is the measurable spec shared by clays, glazes and kilns
Fabric guide: cotton fabrics named by weave/structure (poplin, lawn, twill, denim, canvas, jersey, flannel) and GSM weight classes (under 100 to 400+); advice to ask weight and weave not just fibre
